name: Kadowaki Kaede
source:
After being raped by someone, she was isolated in a hut deep in the mountains outside the village for breaking the law of the village. She was also shackled and chained to prevent her from escaping. She has no memory of the last few years due to the shock of being raped. She continues to believe that she has been confined in the hut since she has been a bad person.
